## SpaceX Unveils $16.8B 'Terafab' Manufacturing Facility and Enters Mobile Networking

A $16.8B manufacturing facility signals serious vertical integration ambition; the mobile network entry is the more strategically novel move — it introduces SpaceX as a potential competitor to terrestrial carriers and could open a recurring-revenue stream that changes the long-run margin profile of SPCX.

- SpaceX has announced a facility called 'Terafab' valued at $16.8B, per the headline — a major disclosed capex commitment.
- Simultaneously, a new mobile network was announced, extending SpaceX's addressable market beyond launch and satellite services.
- The dual announcement represents both a large capital program and entry into a new competitive vertical.
- Both developments are consistent with and materially extend the space_economy thesis.
